queries_run: MSCI expense guidance raise 2026 acquisitions margin
MSCI Q2 2026 earnings analyst estimate revision price target cut

findings.claim: 分析師共識維持 Buy／Strong Buy，平均目標價約 $692–$713（不同彙整站數字略有差異），最低 $570、最高 $760；平均目標價較現價估計有約 24.5% 上行空間
findings.source: stockanalysis.com / wallstreetzen.com 分析師預測彙整頁
findings.excerpt: According to 18 analysts polled by S&P Global, MSCI Inc. stock has a consensus rating of "Buy" and an average price target of $692.06. The lowest analyst price target is $570 (+2.57%) and the highest is $760 (+36.76%).

findings.claim: MSCI 2026 Q2 財報後上修 2026 全年費用 guidance：營運費用上修至 $1,535M–$1,575M（原 $1,490M–$1,530M），Adjusted EBITDA 費用上修至 $1,340M–$1,370M（原 $1,305M–$1,335M），主因近期併購（含 First Street）及 AUM 動能超過先前假設
findings.source: MSCI Reports Financial Results for Second Quarter and Six Months 2026 (businesswire/ir.msci.com)
findings.excerpt: the company updated operating expense guidance to $1,535M–$1,575M (up from $1,490M–$1,530M) and adjusted EBITDA expense guidance to $1,340M–$1,370M (up from $1,305M–$1,335M)

findings.claim: Q2 2026 財報後，JPMorgan（Alexander Hess）維持 Overweight 但目標價由 $742 下修至 $700；Evercore ISI（David Motemeden）維持 Outperform 但目標價由 $746 下修至 $722，理由是費用上升軌跡導致估值重新校準
findings.source: BigGo Finance: "MSCI Beats Q2 Estimates but Analysts Slash Price Targets on Rising Costs"
findings.excerpt: JP Morgan analyst Alexander Hess kept an Overweight rating on MSCI but cut the price target to $700 from $742. Evercore ISI Group analyst David Motemeden maintained an Outperform rating and lowered the target to $722 from $746

findings.claim: MSCI Q2 2026 每股盈餘與營收數字在不同彙整站出現不一致版本：部分來源稱 EPS $4.94 優於共識 $4.90（小幅超預期），另有來源稱 EPS $4.94 不及共識 $5.03（不如預期）；營收 $867M 亦分別被稱為優於／不如共識 $864M vs $883.8M。無法從搜尋摘要判定哪個共識基準正確，需查證交易所申報或原始財報稿
findings.source: Investing.com transcript vs 247wallst.com/basisreport.com 對照矛盾

capital_markets_pricing.note: Q2 2026 財報後市場出現「營收/EPS 是否 beat」的來源矛盾，但費用 guidance 上修＋分析師目標價下修（維持買評但降目標價）方向一致：市場對成本上升的擔憂大於對頂線動能的認可。
